name: Source Identifier Conventions
description: Source-language naming guidance to convert into MDC prose. Patterns are illustrative, not identifier, reserved-word or schema validators. The legacy filename is retained for compatibility.
author: Promptcraft

rules.message: TypeScript/JavaScript variables and functions should use camelCase
Classes and types should use PascalCase
Python variables and functions should use snake_case
Use mixedCaps for Go identifiers; initial uppercase controls export visibility, including constants. Validate names with Go tooling.
